title: Career portfolio snippets and manager prep
content:
Purpose: a compact set of one-paragraph evidence snippets I can drop into a 1-pager for my manager, into a calibration packet, or into a promotion narrative. Raw, minimal editing — keep it bite-sized.

Quick usage notes:
- Use this as a source of anecdotes during 1:1s and calibration.
- Each snippet is formatted: Context → My action → Impact (metrics where possible) → Who to ask for corroboration.
- Keep to one short paragraph each; I can expand later if needed.

SNIPPETS (pick and paste)

1) Onboarding playbook and cross-team adoption
Context: New-hire ramp for infra roles in 2025 was inconsistent; bugs in creds and network flummoxed 3 new hires in the first week.
Action: Drafted a condensed onboarding playbook (network checks, credential flows, first-90-day checklist) and ran 2 onboarding workshops with infra and SRE. Created a lightweight `onboarding-checklist.md` and a short Slack flow to triage early access issues.
Impact: Reduced time-to-first-PR for infra hires from ~12 days to ~6 days in first cohort; first-week support tickets down 40%. Workshop feedback: 4.6/5.
Corroborators: Jia (infra lead), Priya (new hire cohort 11).

2) Cost-savings initiative — small wins that stack
Context: Q3 noticed tokenization jobs left idle, wasted GPU minutes between experiments.
Action: Introduced a nightly reclaim cron + lightweight tagging for experiments and a short-run guide for batching small evals. Worked with infra to add a cheap preemptible pool for non-critical workloads.
Impact: Estimated ~18% reduced reserved-GPU spend on the lab environment, reclaimed ~220 GPU hours/month; freed budget for a short-term Dedicated trial.
Corroborators: Sam (platform), finance ticket JIRA-OPS-214.

3) Root cause + follow-up for a production latency regression
Context: Feb regression — median tail latency for chat route spiked ~35% after a kernel upgrade.
Action: Led an incident postmortem, isolated CV kernel mismatch with quantized model paths, tested compatibility matrix, and coordinated a gradual rollback while shipping a compatibility test to CI. Drafted short runbook steps to avoid recurrence.
Impact: Restored latency to baseline within 6 hours; added a CI gate preventing similar upgrades without compatibility tests. Reduced chance of repeat by design.
Corroborators: Ops on-call rota (Julio), PR #79.

4) Small team hiring bar and interview rubric refinement
Context: Interview feedback for people-ops candidates was inconsistent; hiring panel lacked a shared rubric.
Action: Compiled a lean rubric focusing on 4 signals (partnering, ambiguity handling, metrics-orientation, operational judgement). Ran a calibration session across 6 interviewers and updated debrief template.
Impact: Faster alignment in debriefs; offer-to-accept velocity improved (fewer back-and-forths). Interviewer variance dropped per qualitative feedback.
Corroborators: People Ops hiring lead, calibration notes.

5) Pilot: cross-team career growth buddies
Context: Engineers reported siloed career advice; people-ops bandwidth limited for 1:1 career coaching.
Action: Launched a 6-week pilot pairing engineers with cross-team ‘career buddies’ (peer coaching). Wrote short facilitator guide and 3 focused topics (presentation of work, making impact visible, comp conversations).
Impact: 80% of participants reported clearer next steps; one participant used artifacts to successfully negotiate a role expansion.
Corroborators: Pilot survey results, Alyssa (participant).

6) Personal growth — measurement and commitments (quarterly)
Goals Q1–Q2 2026:
- Deliver 2 playbooks (onboarding + incident runbook) — target: March 31.
- Run 3 cross-team calibration workshops — target: May 15.
- Document 10 promotion-ready artifacts for at least 3 ICs — ongoing.
Signals I watch: reduced time-to-onboard, ticket volume after playbook, calibration consistency in notes.

Conversation starters for manager 1:1 (short, use as agenda bullets)
- Quick ask: I want feedback on two snippets above and an intro to the infra lead (for co-hosting the onboarding workshop).
- Compensation prep: In the next calibration window I want to make a case for role growth — can we identify 2 sponsors?
- Headcount ask: Lab automation work could be higher leverage with a 0.5 FTE rotation — ask for approval to prototype.

Open questions / TODOs
- Add numeric backup for hiring rubric impact (need HR export for interview timelines).
- Pull the exact CI test diff and attach as evidence (PR #79).
- Shorten onboarding playbook to a 1-page quickstart — draft this week.

Notes to self (v. informal)
- Keep stories s.m.a.r.t. (specific, measurable) but short — manager likes bullets.
- If manager asks for “impact on org”, map each snippet to one of: ramp, cost, reliability, hiring, ops workload.
- Practice 60-90s summary for each snippet — aim for 45s.

Bottom line: This is my grab-bag of micro-evidence — portable, low-friction, and easy to hand to a manager or drop into a packet. Revisit monthly and prune to highest-impact 5.
